notes.title: Grid Creeps Patch 5
notes.notes:
Hey there, I wasn't expecting to release a patch this soon after the last one, but the difference this change makes is worth a Patch all its own. The AI has been fixed and optimized, improving the middle/late Game experience.

The late Game had an imperfection in the AI logic that is hard to explain; the simple answer is that to find its way the AI switches between methods of pathfinding but would get stuck on one of them. It would have trouble finding its way after running into a barrier. When there were a bunch of Creeps, turrets firing and things were crazy it wasn't easy to see- some Creeps might never have found their way to the HQ if left unchecked though.

As the Game progresses there are more Creeps per Wave, so more Creeps finding their way around the mountains. This would slow the Game down as you progressed up in Levels, making the mid-late Game slow during attacks- even on good computers. This got worse the farther you got in the Game. This has been massively improved, the Game performs significantly better. 

On an unrelated note, I took a Job that will last the rest of this Week and part of next so I won't get as much done in that time. Game Design doesn't pay the Bills yet, but I'm hoping that will change sometime in the next Year or two. I will still be working on the Game- just not as much until this Job is finished. Fear not! I work for myself remodeling so I make my own hours and I'm not going anywhere. If anything, these jobs motivate me more, I want to get out of remodeling permanently and focus %100 of my time on Game Design. I thought you may want to know why I won't be around as much in the immediate future but that's enough about me.

And that's it for this one. There's no official changelog other than to say the AI has been drastically improved. I hope this improves your enjoyment of the Game! Toodle-oo!

notes.title: Grid Creeps Patch 4
notes.notes:
Hey folks, there's a new Patch out! The Holidays slowed me down, but I'm back to getting things done.

The Patch adds 23 Achievements. You will find a list of them below. If you have any Saves you can get some of the Achievements by Loading one of  them, but you won't be able to get all of them this way, you will need to start a New Game to get the rest.

The Upgrade 'All' Button used to only appear when selecting a Wall. It is now working for everything that you can Upgrade. I have been wanting to add this for a while, it was time consuming, but it's one more feature I can check off the list. Hopefully this will save you some time when you're building many Towers at once.

I've added 5 stats on the Main Menu- Red, Green, Blue and Yellow Creep Kills along with  Total Kills. From here on out you'll be able to keep track of your Kills.  In the future there will be a dedicated Section that tracks this and many more statistics, the Main Menu is a temporary spot for showing this. It was tracking these stats for the Achievements anyway so I thought I may as well display them somewhere, and since there is one of each Creep on the Main Menu, I'd put it next to them until I get the other Stats added- you'll see them when you boot up the Game.

Expect a progress report soon to let you know what is going on moving forward. If anyone has any feedback, please let me know! 

[h3]Achievements[/h3]

1 Novice: Kill 50 Creeps

2 Good: Kill 500 Creeps

3 Epic: Kill 1,000 Creeps

4 Master: Kill 5,000 Creeps

5 King: Kill 10,000 Creeps

6 Red Slayer: Kill 1,000 Red Creeps

7 Green Slayer: Kill 1,000 Green Creeps

8 Blue Slayer: Kill 2,500 Blue or Mini Creeps

9 Yellow Slayer: Kill 1,000 Yellow Creeps

10 Carpenter: Build All Wood Based Towers in the same Game (Archer, Fire Archer, Crossbow, Ballista)

11 Iron Smith: Build All Iron Based Towers in the same Game (Sentry Gun, Shotgun, Mgun, Sniper)

12 Steel Smith: Build All Steel Based Towers in the same Game (Cannon, Artillery, Rocket, Missile)

13 Engineer: Build All Power Based Towers in the same Game (Blaster, Lightning, Laser, Rail Gun)

14 Tower Master: Build All Towers in the same Game (16 Total)

15 Builder: Build at least one of each Building/Mine

16 Outpost: Survive to Wave 5

17 Village: Survive to Wave 10

18 Town: Survive to Wave 25

19 City: Survive to Wave 50

20 Metropolis: Survive to Wave 75

21 Capital: Survive to Wave 100

22 Wood Challenge: Survive to Wave 30 using only Wood Based Towers

23 Iron Challenge: Survive to Wave 30 using only Iron Based Towers

notes.title: Grid Creeps Patch 3
notes.notes:
Time for Update number 3! Happy Holidays!

While the changelog is not long, there is one big feature that has been added with this Update- the High Score system. When selecting which map you want to play on you can see the Highest Wave you've gotten to for each Difficulty. You will need to start new Games in order for it to record your scores though, Save Games from before this update won't count, though you can still play them. 
*For clarification- this is only pre-Patch Saves, you can Save/Load Post-Patch Saves and they'll still count toward the High Score as they should.

The Steam API is also now working with the Game. You should be able to use Steam normally while in Game. This is the first step to adding achievements which I hope to get working with the next Update.

Achievements and the new Tutorial are the big Goals for the next Update. the Tutorial has been halfway done since last update; It took most of the Week to get the High Score system finished so I didn't get to work on it at all. You can also expect more Overall improvements to the Game with the next Update.

The next Update will probably be about 2 Weeks from this post, though I'll post a Progress Report sometime next Week to let you all know what's going on.

Hope your Holidays are going well, and Happy Early New-Year!




[h3]v.0.6.43 Changelog[/h3]


-High Score system added. This shows the Highest Wave you have gotten to for each Level/Difficulty. The High Score updates on Game Over. Sandbox Mode does not keep track of High Scores.
	*Saves from before this patch aren't compatible with the system. While you can continue to play old Saves, they won't count towards a High Score.

-Steam API has been added- you should be able to use Steam and its features while in Game now. This is also the first step to linking Achievements.

-Fixed crash when selecting Crossbow after converting from the Archer.

-Coal Mine was labeled Coal Cutter... it is properly labeled now.
        EDIT: It is still labeled Coal Cutter. I guess I didn't fix that after all. So ya, it's fixed now but I don't think a Patch just for this is worth it, so next patch it will be fixed.

notes.title: Grid Creeps Patch 2
notes.notes:
Hello again Folks, It’s time for another Patch! I have been very busy improving the Game over the last couple Weeks.  I have still been primarily addressing feedback and trying to get the HUD to a more finalized state and it has been some work! Quite a bit more than I thought actually- partly because I made more changes that I was originally planning, but also because HUD work is time consuming.

Seeing other people play and the feedback I got highlighted how the HUD had some problems and information in some places was vague, hard to read, in need of a background, or in some cases misleading; I saw how, in being the developer, there are things that are obvious to me (because I made the Game), but aren’t obvious to other people. I thought a lot about how I could make important information more plain to see and straight-forward to access, how I could make the game more intuitive and easier to play and I made the changes that needed to be made. That thinking eats up a lot of time which I still forget to take into account! The Game should just plain be easier to play.

There are still some smaller things I want to improve about the HUD, but I believe that this may be the first 1.0-worthy version of it. I was hoping to get the High Score system in this update but I really wanted to nail down the HUD. I am hoping that the next patch will be about 1 Week from the release of this patch, give or take a day or two. I’m about half-way done with both the High Score system and the new Tutorial. I hope to get both of these out by then, but things never go %100 according to plan. Or maybe things go faster than expected, an earlier than expected release would be nice. In any case, there's still a lot to do, expect updates regularly for the next few months. 

Anyway, I've added 4 new screenshots. I hope that this newest version is to your liking! Thank you all for your help, your opinions are Gold to this project. Please tell me what kind of changes you think could make this game better! Take care everyone!


[h3]v.0.05.42 Changelog- [/h3]

-After 3 upgrades (Level 4) you can convert your Tower into something better. The Archer can convert into a Fire Archer, Crossbow or Ballista – the Sentry Gun can convert into a Shotgun, Machine Gun or Sniper. The Cannon and Blaster have their own conversions as well. It was not made clear to the player that this mechanic has been in the Game since the beginning. Before, the buttons to convert into these Towers were hidden until you had upgraded the Tower to Level 4. Now, they are visible any time you select the Tower- if your Tower is at Level 1-3  the unusable version of the button is visible and if you mouse over the button it will give you information about the Tower and it tells you in clear Yellow text that you need to Upgrade to Level 4 before you can convert the Tower. The buttons always being there for the player to investigate and the information you get from trying to use them should make this mechanic much more obvious. 

-HUD has seen many more improvements. Smaller tweaks may not be listed. 

-All In-Game text now has backgrounds which should make all of the text much easier to read.

-New Font: Dosis- the old letters were all the same width, for example- an 'i' took up just as much space as a 'W', which gave an odd look to certain words depending on their spelling and made words longer than they need to be. The new Font varies in width, so an 'i' takes up less space than the 'W'. Words are a bit shorter and some text required some editing. *I may not have caught everything yet; Some text may not be perfectly placed but this should be rare. The new Font also fits more in with the vision I have of the Final Product, I hope you like the new look better!
	-This allowed me to shrink parts of the HUD further.
	**Font has only been changed for the HUD/Gameplay, Out of Game Menus still use the old Font- this will be updated to match at some point as well.

-When hovering over one of the Buy buttons text would appear above it with information about cost and a description. When you couldn't afford something it would tell you what you needed, but it was hard to read and was easy to miss/ignore. This information has all been moved to the right side of the screen, a background has been added and descriptions revised. When buying something it should be much more clear what you are getting. And when you can't afford something it is easier to tell why- it highlights what you are short on in red if you don't have what you need to build something.
	*Houses and Walls also said they required Population, they don't and never actually did- the description was wrong. This has been fixed.

-The buttons on the left side of the screen have been changed. Before there were 5 permanent Menu/Options/etc. buttons that were always there. Now there is just one button that accesses the others. when selected the others appear and you can exit the game or return to the menu. 'Escape' also toggles these Buttons and like everything else, right click can cancel these Menus/buttons.

-Food, Population, Warehouse Limit information has been made a little bit smaller. These and the Resource Bars that are under them have been moved to the right, giving the player yet more screen space.

-The background behind 'Wave:#' in the top middle has been made even smaller to account for the new Font.

-When starting or loading a Game, you would need to hit the space bar twice to Pause, though clicking the Pause button has always worked properly. Now you don’t have to double tap the space bar the first time to Pause the Game.

-When anything you have built is selected the information that pops up in the upper right corner of the screen has been made smaller, giving *drumroll*… more screen-space!

-If you want to upgrade a selected Tower or Mine and cannot you are either short on Gold, Resources or Population. It always told you how much of each is required, but gave no clear signs what you were short on; now it highlights what you are short on in Red.

-When placing your Headquarters the round Preview marker now changes colors depending on what resources are in range of the HQ, this should help Players find a Good spot to place the HQ. This isn’t listed anywhere in-game yet (just one little thing I haven’t gotten to yet): Red = no Gold or Wood in range, Yellow = only Wood or only Gold in range but the other is not, Grey = Wood and Gold are in Range but Iron is not, Dark Green = Gold, Wood and Iron are in range but Coal is not, Bright Green = All Resources are in range. Grey or either of the Greens are likely good starting spots.

-The Laser used to go through Mountains/Terrain Obstructions. Lasers are stopped by them now.

-Many Tower/Building/Mine descriptions have been edited/revised, giving more useful information and explaining things more clearly.

-Main Buy Buttons along the bottom have been shaded to match the Button's border. This makes it a little bit easier to tell the different groups apart. Hopefully you will agree that it also just plain look better.

-If you right clicked while hovering over a Tower Conversion button or Target Priority you would no longer be able to select any of what you have built (though buttons were still usable). It was caused by a simple code order issue. This has been fixed.

-In the beginning of the Tutorial it tells you the menu is the Save button- shrinking the HUD moved the side buttons up but i missed moving this reference to it. Fixed.

-There were some obvious grammar errors in the Tutorial that I thought were fixed for the last update but they were not (which I am a little confused about). In any case, I have gone through the Tutorial and fixed everything I found, though there may still be small imperfections (New Tutorial coming soon so I'm only worrying about the big mistakes).

-In certain circumstances there may have been a crash when clicking on an unusable upgrade button. This is fixed.

-The Game may have been Pausing automatically when placing your Headquarters- it does not do this anymore.

-When upgrading sometimes the selected tower/wall/mine would deselect. This should no longer happen

-Added preview to Out of Game Options for the Transparency Level. You could adjust it before through the Menu but since it only applies to in-game HUD backgrounds there was no way to see a preview before.

-There have also been a lot of other general small fixes/tweaks.

notes.title: Mini-Patch 2 v 0.04.39
notes.notes:
I realized that the Game Over section of the screen turns White- I had to add a bit of code to the HUD to make the transparency adjustable and missed the Game Over background. This is fixed now.

I thought it was important that Players be able to read the Game Over screen. I guess I need to let the Games I play finish more often! That's how I caught it- I admit, I do play a lot myself. Thanks for your support folks! I'll be releasing another Progress Report soon.

notes.title: Grid Creeps Patch 1
notes.notes:
It's been a week, and I have been busy. I have the first regular patch, which addresses many issues. A lot of improvements have been made and bugs addressed. I've gotten some good feedback and hope that this Update reflects that. I haven't addressed everything I want to based on the feedback I've gotten, but I hope you'll agree, there are some big improvements! Read the change log below to see the biggest changes this week-


-Major HUD changes. Compare the first and second screenshot to see the update.

-HUD Buttons have been Updated to match the style of the Game. The Buttons should be easier to read and just plain look better.

-The HUD background Opacity was too transparent, making it hard to read text sometimes. An Option has been added that allows you to choose your own level of transparency any time.

-The 'Wave:', 'Gold:' and Gold 'Income' Information Text (Largest Text) has been made smaller and the HUD background behind these things has been shifted to account for the smaller size, giving the Player more screenspace.

-The Tower Target Priority buttons were very large, also taking up a lot of screen-space. They are much smaller, giving you a better view of the Level when a Tower is selected.

-Options settings were not loading as intended in many situations, giving the appearance that it wasn't remembering your settings between games and Options were acting strange in general. It was referencing the wrong file type when checking to see if a certain file existed when re-starting the Game, loading a Level and starting a new Game. Now in all these cases, the Game will remember the Options settings and should operate as expected. 

-Added preview to the Farm Land Build Area and added a Build effect to the Farm Land. This should fix a few different small problems with Building Farms and assist in planning your Base. It also disallows building on future Farm land that is in the Build Process.

-Converting the Archer Tower to the Ballista Tower causes the Tower to be Destroyed. This was a minor code flaw and has been fixed, you can convert an Archer into a Ballista without any problems now.

-The Tutorial has been Edited to help better explain itself and the Game. (I am currently working on a much better Tutorial to replace this one)

-After level 20 the last few creeps per Wave will catch on fire. This is to temporarily address a small problem with the AI finding the HQ in certain circumstances during the late Game. In the future I will be doing some work on the AI which will address this and make it a little bit smarter.

-When selecting the Blaster or Laser Towers they both had the wrong label, although the other information about each Tower was correct. This has been fixed.

-Disabled the ability to Save on the empty Loading Level. (Game would crash when loading a Save performed here)

-When exiting from the Main screen, if you clicked on the 'Exit Game' Button more than once it would create multiple Yes/No Buttons. No more!


-In the Archer Description when Selected it said the Archer can miss, this is an error that has been fixed- the Archer, Fire Archer and Crossbow never miss, though the Ballista can.

-Many other minor bugs/improvements have been made as well.


That's all for this first Week. I expect to release the next patch sometime within the next Week or Two, so let me know what changes you want to see!

notes.title: Mini-Patch 1 (v.0.03.37)
notes.notes:
This bug was reported earlier today by a Player.

-If a Tower, Mine, or Wall that was Selected got Destroyed the Upgrade/Target Priority Buttons wouldn't disappear. The code used the selected object's ID (an arbitrary number assigned by the game) but since it didn't exist anymore due to it having been destroyed the Game got mad and rage-quit. Now the buttons know they are suppose to go away when the tower does so the Game will remain happy and won't rage-quit on you anymore.

If you find a bug that causes the game to crash then a grey box will pop up, gives an error and bits of code. If you can get the information to me through a screenshot or copy/pasting I will try to fix it immediately. 

-There is a known issue when alt-tabbing. you will get an error box like the game is crashing but there will be an option to ignore- do just that, it doesn't cause any problems. This minor bug has to do with the buildable area showing when alt-tabbing/minimizing, the code is kept in temporary memory which is wiped when alt-tabbing/minimizing but as soon as you ignore it the game continues like nothing happened. This will be fixed soon.
